sources.name: CodeWhale configuration and doctor contract
facts: doctor/setup/session commands are documented as codewhale-tui surfaces
codewhale-tui doctor --json returns machine-readable data and redacted config-validation errors
managed configuration and project-level extension paths can affect startup

sources.name: CodeWhale public guide
facts: the public guide still demonstrates codewhale doctor and codewhale doctor --json, creating a command-surface documentation conflict

sources.name: Claude Code release feed
facts: v2.1.200 fixed background sessions stopping after sleep/wake and stale daemon recovery problems

sources.name: OpenCode CLI
facts: environment variables and project .env may also provide credentials

sources.name: Aider YAML configuration
facts: .aider.conf.yml is searched in git root, cwd and home
the default .env location is the git root
notifications can be configured without implying a full permission protocol

sources.name: Tauri capabilities and window API
facts: capabilities constrain which WebViews can invoke commands
setIgnoreCursorEvents remains a strict boolean API
native cursor position and scale-factor APIs remain available in Tauri 2.11.5

interpretation: R7 resolves conflicting CodeWhale command surfaces with an auditable fallback, treats authentication/config/version findings as scoped evidence rather than universal launch blockers, and prevents the always-on renderer from selecting a diagnostic directory that could load untrusted project state.
